6.1.definition: A system, or group of systems, that enforces an access control policy between networks.
6.1.cloze: A ___ is a system, or group of systems, that enforces an access control policy between networks.
6.1.ru: Система, применяющая политику доступа между сетями.

6.1.term: The three common properties all firewalls share
6.1.definition: They are resistant to network attacks, they are the only transit point between internal and external networks so all traffic flows through them, and they enforce the access control policy.
items: The only transit point between internal and external networks
6.1.ru: Устойчив к атакам, единственная точка транзита, применяет политику доступа.

6.1.term: The benefits of using a firewall in a network
6.1.definition: They prevent exposure of sensitive hosts and applications to untrusted users, sanitize protocol flow to prevent exploitation of protocol flaws, block malicious data from servers and clients, and reduce security management complexity by off-loading network access control to a few firewalls.
items: Prevent the exposure of sensitive hosts, resources, and applications to untrusted users
Sanitize protocol flow, which prevents the exploitation of protocol flaws
Block malicious data from servers and clients
decoys: Remove the need for user authentication
6.1.ru: Прячут важные хосты, чистят протоколы, режут вредные данные, упрощают управление.

6.1.definition: A misconfigured firewall can become a single point of failure, data from many applications cannot be passed over firewalls securely, users might search for ways around the firewall, network performance can slow down, and unauthorized traffic can be tunneled or hidden as legitimate traffic.
items: A misconfigured firewall can become a single point of failure
The data from many applications cannot be passed securely
Users might proactively search for ways around the firewall
Unauthorized traffic can be tunneled or hidden as legitimate traffic
decoys: Firewalls only work on wireless networks
6.1.ru: Единая точка отказа, не всё проходит безопасно, обходные пути, падение скорости, туннелирование.

6.1.definition: Demilitarized zone: a firewall design with one inside interface connected to the private network, one outside interface connected to the public network, and one DMZ interface.
6.1.ru: Три интерфейса: внутренний, внешний и отдельная зона для публичных сервисов.

6.1.term: What happens to traffic from the public network toward the private network
6.1.definition: It is blocked.
6.1.ru: Из публичной сети во внутреннюю трафик блокируется.

6.1.term: What kind of traffic is selectively permitted from the public network toward the DMZ
6.1.definition: Typically email, DNS, HTTP, or HTTPS traffic; return traffic from the DMZ to the public network is dynamically permitted.
6.1.ru: Обычно почта, DNS, HTTP и HTTPS.

6.1.definition: Zone-based policy firewall: a firewall that uses zones, where a zone is a group of one or more interfaces that have similar functions or features.
6.1.ru: Интерфейсы со схожими функциями группируются в зоны, политика пишется между зонами.

6.1.term: Default ZPF behaviour for traffic inside one zone and between zones
6.1.definition: Traffic between interfaces in the same zone passes freely and is not subject to any policy, while all zone-to-zone traffic is blocked until a policy allowing or inspecting it is configured.
6.1.ru: Внутри зоны всё ходит свободно, между зонами всё закрыто до явной политики.

6.1.definition: The only exception to the ZPF default deny any policy: the router itself, including all the router interface IP addresses; by default there is no policy for traffic destined to and sourced from the router.
6.1.ru: Сам маршрутизатор со всеми его IP. Единственное исключение из запрета по умолчанию.

6.1.definition: Usually part of a router firewall, it permits or denies traffic based on Layer 3 and Layer 4 information, using a simple policy table look-up.
6.1.ru: Фильтр по L3 и L4 без запоминания состояния, обычно на маршрутизаторе.

6.1.definition: The most versatile and most common firewall technology; it provides stateful packet filtering using connection information maintained in a state table, is classified at the network layer and also analyzes traffic at OSI Layer 4 and Layer 5.
6.1.ru: Самый распространённый. Держит таблицу состояний соединений, смотрит L4 и L5.

6.1.definition: The table where a stateful firewall maintains connection information.
6.1.ru: Таблица, где stateful firewall хранит состояния соединений.

6.1.definition: Also called a proxy firewall: it filters information at Layers 3, 4, 5, and 7 of the OSI model, mostly in software; the client connects to a proxy server which connects to the remote server on its behalf, so the server only sees a connection from the proxy.
6.1.ru: Прокси-файрвол: фильтрует на L3, L4, L5 и L7, сервер видит только прокси.

6.1.definition: Next-generation firewall: goes beyond stateful firewalls by providing integrated intrusion prevention, application awareness and control to see and block risky apps, upgrade paths for future information feeds, and techniques to address evolving security threats.
6.1.ru: Поверх stateful: встроенное предотвращение вторжений и контроль приложений.

6.1.definition: A PC or server with firewall software running on it.
6.1.ru: Файрвол как программа на самом ПК или сервере.

6.1.definition: A firewall that filters IP traffic between a pair of bridged interfaces.
6.1.ru: Фильтрует между двумя мостовыми интерфейсами, незаметен для сети.

6.1.definition: A combination of the various firewall types; for example an application inspection firewall combines a stateful firewall with an application gateway firewall.
6.1.ru: Комбинация нескольких типов сразу.

6.1.definition: Intrusion detection system: deployed in offline mode, it detects attacks but cannot stop the trigger packet.
6.1.ru: Система обнаружения вторжений, работает в offline-режиме.

6.1.definition: Intrusion prevention system: the more scalable, inline system that can drop the trigger packets and stop an attack.
6.1.ru: Система предотвращения вторжений, стоит в разрыве трафика.

6.1.definition: A set of rules that an IDS or IPS uses to detect malicious activity; signatures detect severe breaches of security, common network attacks, and gather information.
6.1.cloze: A ___ is a set of rules that an IDS or IPS uses to detect malicious activity.
6.1.ru: Набор правил, по которым IDS или IPS распознаёт вредоносную активность.

6.1.definition: A signature pattern detected in a single packet.
6.1.ru: Срабатывает по одному пакету.

6.1.definition: A signature pattern detected across multiple packets.
6.1.ru: Срабатывает по нескольким пакетам.

6.1.term: The forms an IDS or IPS sensor can take
6.1.definition: A router configured with Cisco IOS IPS software, a device specifically designed to provide dedicated IDS or IPS services, or a network module installed in an adaptive security appliance (ASA), switch, or router.
items: A router configured with Cisco IOS IPS software
A device specifically designed to provide dedicated IDS or IPS services
A network module installed in an ASA, switch, or router
6.1.ru: Маршрутизатор с IOS IPS, отдельное устройство или модуль в ASA, коммутаторе, маршрутизаторе.

6.1.term: No impact on network latency or jitter, because it is deployed offline
6.1.definition: IDS — работает вне разрыва трафика.
6.1.ru: Не влияет на задержки, значит IDS.

6.1.term: Response action cannot stop the trigger packet
6.1.definition: IDS — только обнаруживает, не блокирует.
6.1.ru: Не может остановить пакет-триггер, значит IDS.

6.1.term: More vulnerable to network security evasion techniques because it is not inline
6.1.definition: IDS — стоит в стороне от трафика.
6.1.ru: Уязвим к обходным техникам, значит IDS.

6.1.term: Can be configured to drop the trigger packets
6.1.definition: IPS — стоит в разрыве трафика и блокирует.
6.1.ru: Может отбросить пакет-триггер, значит IPS.

6.1.definition: IPS — собирает поток заново, потому что стоит inline.
6.1.ru: Нормализация потока это IPS.

6.1.term: Can affect network performance by introducing latency and jitter
6.1.definition: IPS — весь трафик идёт через него.
6.1.ru: Вносит задержку и джиттер, значит IPS.

6.1.term: Must be sized so that time-sensitive applications such as VoIP are not adversely affected
6.1.definition: IPS — из-за inline-размещения.
6.1.ru: Надо считать нагрузку из-за VoIP, значит IPS.

6.1.definition: A technique used by inline IPS sensors to reconstruct the data stream when the attack occurs over multiple data segments.
6.1.ru: Пересборка потока, когда атака размазана по нескольким сегментам.

6.1.term: How IDS and IPS complement each other
6.1.definition: An IDS can be implemented to validate IPS operation because the IDS can be configured for deeper packet inspection offline, allowing the IPS to focus on fewer but more critical traffic patterns inline.
6.1.ru: IDS глубоко копает офлайн и проверяет работу IPS, а IPS держит критичное inline.

6.1.definition: Host-based IPS: software installed on a host to monitor and analyze suspicious activity; it can monitor and protect the operating system and critical system processes specific to that host.
6.1.ru: IPS как программа на самом хосте, защищает ОС и её процессы.

6.1.term: What HIPS can be thought of as a combination of
6.1.definition: Antivirus software, antimalware software, and a firewall.
6.1.ru: Антивирус плюс антивредонос плюс файрвол.

6.1.definition: Provides protection specific to a host operating system, provides operating system and application level protection, and protects the host after the message is decrypted.
items: Provides protection specific to a host operating system
Provides operating system and application level protection
Protects the host after the message is decrypted
decoys: Sees the whole network at once
Works without being installed on the host
6.1.ru: Защита под конкретную ОС, на уровне ОС и приложений, уже после расшифровки.

6.1.definition: It is operating system dependent and must be installed on all hosts; it operates only at a local level and does not have a complete view of the network.
items: Must be installed on all hosts
6.1.ru: Зависит от ОС, нужен на каждом хосте, не видит картину сети целиком.

6.1.definition: An IPS implemented using a dedicated or non-dedicated IPS device, where sensors deployed at designated network points detect malicious and unauthorized activity in real time and can take action when required.
6.1.ru: Сенсоры в узлах сети видят активность в реальном времени независимо от цели атаки.

6.1.definition: Cisco Advanced Malware Protection: an enterprise-class advanced malware analysis and protection solution providing protection before, during and after an attack, with continuous monitoring of all file activity.
6.1.ru: Защита от вредоносов до, во время и после атаки, с непрерывным наблюдением за файлами.

6.1.definition: Cisco Web Security Appliance: a secure web gateway that protects the network by automatically blocking risky sites and testing unknown sites before allowing users to access them.
6.1.ru: Шлюз веб-безопасности: блокирует опасные сайты и проверяет незнакомые.

6.1.definition: Cisco Email Security Appliance: helps mitigate email-based threats and defends mission-critical email systems, constantly updated by real-time feeds from Cisco Talos.
6.1.ru: Защита почты, питается данными Talos в реальном времени.

6.1.definition: Cisco Cloud Web Security: protects user PCs that connect to the internet directly outside the protected network, such as at a public Wi-Fi service, giving remote workers the same level of security as onsite employees.
6.1.ru: Закрывает дыру WSA: защищает тех, кто выходит в интернет мимо корпоративной сети.

6.1.definition: The Cisco Talos Security Intelligence and Research Group, which detects and correlates threats in real time using the largest threat-detection network in the world and provides a 24-hour view into global traffic activity.
6.1.ru: Исследовательская группа Cisco, крупнейшая сеть обнаружения угроз.

6.1.definition: Global threat intelligence, spam blocking, advanced malware protection, and outbound message control.
6.1.ru: Глобальная разведка угроз, антиспам, AMP, контроль исходящих писем.

6.2.definition: Access Control List: a series of commands that control whether a device forwards or drops packets based on information found in the packet header.
6.2.cloze: An ___ is a series of commands that control whether a device forwards or drops packets based on information found in the packet header.
6.2.ru: Набор команд: пропустить или отбросить пакет по данным из его заголовка.

6.2.term: The tasks ACLs perform when configured
6.2.definition: They limit network traffic to increase network performance, provide traffic flow control, provide a basic level of security for network access, filter traffic based on traffic type, and screen hosts to permit or deny access to network services.
items: Limit network traffic to increase network performance
Provide a basic level of security for network access
Filter traffic based on traffic type
Screen hosts to permit or deny access to network services
6.2.ru: Ограничить трафик, управлять потоками, дать базовую защиту, фильтровать по типу, закрыть сервисы.

6.2.definition: A Cisco IPv4 ACL that can permit or deny traffic only from source IPv4 addresses; the destination of the packet and the ports involved are not evaluated.
6.2.ru: Смотрит только на IPv4-адрес источника.

6.2.definition: A Cisco IPv4 ACL that filters packets based on protocol type, source and destination IPv4 addresses, source and destination TCP or UDP ports, and optional protocol type information for finer control.
6.2.ru: Смотрит на протокол, оба адреса, оба порта и дополнительные признаки.

6.2.term: The attributes an extended ACL filters on
6.2.definition: Protocol type, source IPv4 address, destination IPv4 address, source TCP or UDP ports, destination TCP or UDP ports, and optional protocol type information.
6.2.ru: Протокол, оба адреса, оба порта и уточнения по протоколу.

6.2.term: Why a name can be used instead of a number to identify an ACL
6.2.definition: A number does not provide information about the purpose of the ACL, while a name does.
6.2.ru: Номер ничего не говорит о назначении списка, имя говорит.

6.2.definition: A configuration that generates and logs an ACL message when traffic meets the permit or deny criteria defined in the ACL.
6.2.ru: Пишет сообщение, когда трафик попал под правило.

6.2.term: What allowing only TCP traffic with an ACK or RST bit set achieves
6.2.definition: Only traffic from an established TCP session is permitted, which denies any TCP traffic from outside the network trying to establish a new TCP session.
6.2.ru: Пропускает только уже установленные TCP-сессии, новые снаружи режет.

6.2.definition: Simple Network Management Protocol: an application layer protocol that allows administrators to manage end devices on an IP network, providing a message format for communication between managers and agents.
6.2.ru: Протокол прикладного уровня для управления устройствами в IP-сети.

6.2.definition: The element of the SNMP system that runs SNMP management software and is part of a network management system (NMS).
6.2.ru: Сторона, которая управляет. Часть системы NMS.

6.2.definition: The nodes being monitored and managed in the SNMP system.
6.2.ru: Управляемый узел.

6.2.definition: Management Information Base: a database on the agents that stores data and operational statistics about the device.
6.2.ru: База данных на агенте со статистикой по устройству.

6.2.term: The manager collects information from an agent
6.2.definition: get — запрос данных у агента.
6.2.ru: Сбор данных с агента это get.

6.2.term: The manager changes configurations on an agent
6.2.definition: set — изменение конфигурации агента.
6.2.ru: Изменение конфигурации это set.

6.2.term: The agent forwards information directly to the network manager on its own
6.2.definition: trap — агент сам шлёт уведомление.
6.2.ru: Агент сам инициирует отправку, это trap.

6.2.definition: A Cisco IOS technology that provides statistics on packets flowing through a Cisco router or multilayer switch, focused on IP packet flow statistics.
6.2.ru: Технология Cisco: статистика по потокам IP-пакетов через маршрутизатор или коммутатор.

6.2.definition: SNMP attempts to provide a very wide range of network management features and options, while NetFlow is focused on providing statistics on IP packets flowing through network devices.
6.2.ru: SNMP это широкое управление, NetFlow это узко статистика по потокам.

6.2.definition: The external server to which NetFlow pushes the statistics it gathers.
6.2.ru: Внешний сервер, куда NetFlow сгружает статистику.

6.2.term: The seven fields original NetFlow used to distinguish flows
6.2.definition: Source IP address, destination IP address, source port number, destination port number, Layer 3 protocol type, Type of Service (ToS) marking, and input logical interface.
6.2.ru: Два адреса, два порта, протокол L3, метка ToS и входной логический интерфейс.

6.2.definition: The Type of Service byte in the IPv4 header that holds information about how devices should apply quality of service (QoS) rules to the packets in that flow.
6.2.ru: Байт в заголовке IPv4, по которому применяют правила QoS.

6.2.definition: Also known as a packet sniffer or traffic sniffer: typically software that captures packets entering and exiting the network interface card (NIC).
6.2.ru: Программа, перехватывающая пакеты на сетевой карте.

6.2.definition: A feature that allows a switch to make duplicate copies of traffic passing through it and send them out a port with a network monitor attached, while the original traffic is forwarded in the usual manner.
6.2.cloze: ___ allows a switch to make duplicate copies of traffic and send them out a port with a network monitor attached.
6.2.ru: Коммутатор копирует трафик на порт с анализатором, оригинал идёт как обычно.

6.2.term: Why traffic sniffers cannot see all traffic on a switched segment
6.2.definition: Because network switches isolate traffic, so sniffers and other network monitors such as IDS cannot access all the traffic on a network segment.
6.2.ru: Коммутатор изолирует трафик, поэтому анализатор видит не всё.

6.2.definition: The most common protocol for accessing system messages; it allows networking devices to send their system messages across the network to syslog servers.
6.2.ru: Протокол отправки системных сообщений устройств на сервер.

6.2.term: The three primary functions of the syslog logging service
6.2.definition: The ability to gather logging information for monitoring and troubleshooting, to select the type of logging information that is captured, and to specify the destination of captured syslog messages.
items: Gather logging information for monitoring and troubleshooting
Select the type of logging information that is captured
Specify the destination of captured syslog messages
6.2.ru: Собрать логи, выбрать что писать, указать куда отправлять.

6.2.definition: Network Time Protocol: allows routers on the network to synchronize their time settings with an NTP server, so a group of NTP clients obtaining time from a single source have consistent time settings.
6.2.ru: Синхронизация времени устройств с сервером времени.

6.2.term: Why time must be synchronized across all devices
6.2.definition: All aspects of managing, securing, troubleshooting, and planning networks require accurate and consistent timestamping; without it, it is impossible to determine the order of events in different parts of the network.
6.2.ru: Без единого времени не восстановить порядок событий в разных частях сети.

6.2.definition: Each level in the hierarchical system of NTP time sources; the stratum level is defined as the number of hop counts from the authoritative source.
6.2.ru: Уровень в иерархии источников времени, считается в хопах от эталона.

6.2.term: High-precision timekeeping devices assumed to be accurate, the authoritative time sources
6.2.definition: Stratum 0 — эталонные источники времени.
6.2.ru: Сам эталон времени это stratum 0.

6.2.term: Devices directly connected to the authoritative time sources, acting as the primary network time standard
6.2.definition: Stratum 1 — напрямую подключены к эталону.
6.2.ru: Напрямую к эталону это stratum 1.

6.2.term: Servers connected to stratum 1 devices through network connections, which can also serve stratum 3 devices
6.2.definition: Stratum 2 — через сеть от stratum 1.
6.2.ru: Через сеть от stratum 1 это stratum 2.

6.2.term: The NTP max hop count and the stratum that means unsynchronized
6.2.definition: The max hop count is 15; stratum 16, the lowest stratum level, indicates that a device is unsynchronized.
6.2.cloze: Stratum ___ , the lowest stratum level, indicates that a device is unsynchronized.
6.2.ru: Максимум 15 хопов. Stratum 16 значит время не синхронизировано.

6.2.term: What a smaller stratum number means
6.2.definition: Smaller stratum numbers indicate that the server is closer to the authorized time source; the larger the stratum number, the lower the stratum level.
6.2.ru: Чем меньше номер, тем ближе к эталону.

6.2.term: Users and administrators must prove that they are who they say they are
6.2.definition: Authentication — подтверждение личности.
6.2.ru: Доказать, кто ты, это authentication.

6.2.term: Determines which resources the user can access and which operations the user is allowed to perform
6.2.definition: Authorization — что можно делать после входа.
6.2.ru: Что тебе можно, это authorization.

6.2.term: Records what the user does, what is accessed, how long, and any changes that were made
6.2.definition: Accounting — учёт действий.
6.2.ru: Кто что делал и сколько, это accounting.

6.2.definition: Terminal Access Controller Access-Control System Plus: an authentication protocol used to communicate with AAA servers; it is considered the more secure protocol because all TACACS+ protocol exchanges are encrypted.
aliases: terminal access controller access-control system plus
6.2.ru: Протокол к AAA-серверу. Шифрует весь обмен, поэтому считается более безопасным.

6.2.definition: Remote Authentication Dial-In User Service: an authentication protocol used to communicate with AAA servers; it only encrypts the user's password and does not encrypt usernames, accounting information, or any other information carried in the message.
6.2.ru: Шифрует только пароль. Имена и учётные данные идут открыто.

6.2.definition: TACACS+ — транспорт TCP.
6.2.ru: TCP это TACACS+.

6.2.definition: RADIUS — транспорт UDP.
6.2.ru: UDP это RADIUS.

6.2.definition: TACACS+ — шифруется весь пакет.
6.2.ru: Весь пакет шифруется у TACACS+.

6.2.definition: RADIUS — шифруется только пароль.
6.2.ru: Только пароль шифрует RADIUS.

6.2.term: Separates AAA according to the AAA architecture, allowing modularity
6.2.definition: TACACS+ — разделяет все три функции.
6.2.ru: Разделяет A, A и A это TACACS+.

6.2.term: Combines authentication and authorization but separates accounting
6.2.definition: RADIUS — объединяет аутентификацию и авторизацию.
6.2.ru: Склеивает аутентификацию с авторизацией это RADIUS.

6.2.term: Is an open or RFC standard
6.2.definition: RADIUS — открытый стандарт RFC.
6.2.ru: Открытый стандарт это RADIUS.

6.2.term: Provides authorization of router commands on a per-user or per-group basis
6.2.definition: TACACS+ — авторизация команд по пользователю или группе.
6.2.ru: Авторизация команд маршрутизатора это TACACS+.

6.2.definition: A private network that is created over a public network, usually the internet; it uses virtual connections routed through the internet from the organization to the remote site instead of a dedicated physical connection.
6.2.ru: Частная сеть поверх публичной, обычно поверх интернета.

6.2.term: Why a VPN is called virtual and why it is called private
6.2.definition: It is virtual in that it carries information within a private network but that information is actually transported over a public network; it is private in that the traffic is encrypted to keep the data confidential.
6.2.ru: Virtual потому что идёт поверх публичной сети, private потому что трафик шифруется.

6.2.definition: Generic Routing Encapsulation: a tunneling protocol developed by Cisco that can encapsulate a wide variety of network layer protocol packet types inside IP tunnels, creating a virtual point-to-point link.
6.2.ru: Туннельный протокол Cisco, заворачивает разные протоколы в IP-туннель.

6.2.definition: The first VPNs were strictly IP tunnels that did not include authentication or encryption of the data.
6.2.ru: Первые VPN были просто туннелями без аутентификации и шифрования.

6.2.definition: A suite of protocols developed with the backing of the IETF to achieve secure services over IP packet-switched networks; IPsec services allow for authentication, integrity, access control, and confidentiality.
6.2.ru: Набор протоколов IETF: аутентификация, целостность, контроль доступа и конфиденциальность.

6.2.definition: Authentication, integrity, access control, and confidentiality.
6.2.ru: Аутентификация, целостность, контроль доступа, конфиденциальность.

6.2.definition: Multiprotocol Label Switching: a common example of a Layer 3 VPN that can establish any-to-any connectivity to many sites.
6.2.ru: Вариант VPN уровня 3, соединяет много площадок по принципу любая с любой.

6.2.definition: Site-to-site, to securely connect central sites with remote locations, and remote-access, to provide secure remote access to external users travelling or working from home; both can be deployed using IPsec.
6.2.ru: Site-to-site между площадками и remote-access для удалённых сотрудников.
